claim.quote: We report values of $R = \sigma(e^+e^-\to {hadrons})/\sigma(e^+e^-\to\mu^+\mu^-)$ for 85 center-of-mass energies between 2 and 5 GeV measured with the upgraded Beijing Spectrometer at the Beijing Electron-Positron Collider.

date.locator: arXiv abstract page, submission date (hep-ex/0102003, 4 February 2001)
date.note: arXiv submission date; published in Phys. Rev. Lett. 88, 101802 on 25 February 2002.

name: Measurements of the Cross Section for e+e- -> hadrons at Center-of-Mass Energies from 2 to 5 GeV

summary.plain: BESII measured R, the ratio of how often electron-positron collisions make hadrons rather than muon pairs, at 85 collision energies between 2 and 5 GeV, using the upgraded Beijing Spectrometer.
summary.technical: BES: R = σ(e⁺e⁻ → hadrons)/σ(e⁺e⁻ → μ⁺μ⁻) at 85 centre-of-mass energies between 2 and 5 GeV with the upgraded Beijing Spectrometer at BEPC (hep-ex/0102003; Phys. Rev. Lett. 88, 101802, 2002).

title: Measurements of the Cross Section for e+e- -> hadrons at Center-of-Mass Energies from 2 to 5 GeV
why_it_matters: The abstract reports R values at 85 energies between 2 and 5 GeV measured with the upgraded Beijing Spectrometer.
